messages:
anya: Quick proposal — add a "light-mode" telemetry tier for extremely high-volume routes (think embeddings / bulk-encode) so we keep latency/cost predictable while still meeting audit needs.

liam: Sounds useful. How are we defining "light-mode"? full strip vs sampled metadata?

anya: Not full strip. Idea: only collect headers + route metadata + aggregated token counts, plus a tiny hashed fingerprint for dedupe. No request/response bodies unless route is opted-in.

santiago: Two quick questions: 1) how do we handle consented routes that need full debug dumps? 2) is the hash reversible for compliance?

anya: 1) per-route allowlist for "inspect" that overrides light-mode and forces full capture (can be canaried). 2) fingerprint is HMAC-SHA256 with tenant-specific key (non-reversible).

maria: UX ask — can we add a console preview to show sampled vs full rows before rollout? PMs want to eyeball what gets scrubbed. Small mockup: toggle + side-by-side sample.

liam: For the rollout: I'd prefer a staged policy that starts at 0.1% full-capture on canary tenants, then 1% then 100% for allowlist. Also add a quota guard so light-mode doesn't get more than X GB/day in storage.

anya: agreed. propose config like: 
```yaml
route: /v1/embeddings/bulk
telemetry:
  mode: light-mode
  full_capture_canary: 0.001  # 0.1%
  hashing: hmac-sha256
  allowlist_flag: telemetry.inspect
  storage_quota_gb: 10
```

maria: console feature note — show estimated daily storage and token-cost delta when toggling between modes. tiny chart + tooltip.

ops-bot: deploy initiated: telemetry-config-service v2.4 -> canary cluster c-12. (link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/telemetry-config-service) :rocket:

liam: Ops — please add an automated alert if allowed full-capture volume exceeds quota for a tenant for 3 consecutive windows. Also a human-in-loop breakglass.

anya: will add alerts + a manual "pause capture" button in console for SRE/oncall.

audit-bot: FYI: audit checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit/telemetry-checklist — includes HMAC key rotation schedule and separation-of-privileges for allowlist.

devex-bot: Heads-up: adding a short quickstart + sample curl for teams to opt in their routes to the allowlist. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/devex/telemetry-lightmode-quickstart

maria: OK if I mock the console preview and ship a proposal doc? PMs want to sync tomorrow 10am.

anya: yes please, ping me and liam for review before PM sync.

santiago: one last note — we'll need to update SDKs to surface the route-level flags in the request metadata so routing can be deterministic; I'll take it.

liam: SGTM. thanks all :thumbsup:
